vulnerability_mechanism.detail: At affected commit 1802525be27d33e19a9a83c163e331a1d13b1892, a writable kCipByteArrayLength reaches CipAttribute::SetAttrData -> DecodeData and replaces a shared ByteBuf limit with an unbounded wire uint16. Later generic kCipByteArray GetAttrData/EncodeData reads, or SetAttrData/DecodeData writes, according to that inflated limit rather than the real allocation. Issue #47 demonstrates both 64-to-512-byte ASan paths through the public AttributeInsert API; stock Assembly attr 4 is read-only, so the supported scope is API-enabled deployments, not the default sample.

atomic_bic.detail: git log --all --reverse -S and blame independently identify this as the first surviving public commit that jointly added kCipByteArrayLength, the capacity-less ByteBuf representation, and the wire-driven '*bb = ByteBuf(bb->data(), aBuf.get16())' rewrite. Later changes before the fix preserve the same mechanism.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: The immediate parent is present and lacks kCipByteArrayLength and class ByteBuf. Its kCipByteArray decode copies a caller-preconfigured CipByteArray length and contains no network-controlled companion-length rewrite, so the reviewed mechanism is absent.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: The BIC has exactly one parent and is not a merge. Although its diff is broad, the vulnerable lines are first written in this smallest surviving public Git object; no finer member commit is represented in the full, non-shallow clone or linked from the exact public commit page. decomposed_shas remains empty.

affected_release_membership.detail: The advisory names exact affected snapshot 1802525be27d33e19a9a83c163e331a1d13b1892, and git merge-base verifies the BIC is its ancestor. The repository has no tags, so there is no released-version tag membership or version range to assert.

fixed_release_membership.detail: The advisory names exact patch e745d9d4a8ca3a13689066983a1269fe1e567674. It descends from both the BIC and affected snapshot and is an ancestor of current origin/master. The repository has no tags, so fixed status is commit/branch membership only, not a claimed release version.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.detail: The fix parent e8e9dba09bf56962807d3504b783ccdb6287f3e4 still performs the unbounded ByteBuf rebuild. The fix introduces CipByteArray {data, capacity, length}, rejects over-capacity length and data writes, emits only validated length bytes, and maps rejection to kCipErrorInvalidAttributeValue, directly closing both read and write variants.
